## Changes
- **Interpolated Raster is ready sooner again.** On a 250-building padel project with sloping ground, contour support refinement now takes about 35 s instead of 57 s in 0.38.0. Calculated levels are unchanged: validation grids are bit-identical, and refined levels agree to within a trillionth of a decibel.
- **What made the difference:** area sources are subdivided (ISO 9613-2 Clause 4) and lateral path lengths (7.4.3) worked out by compiled code that reproduces the previous arithmetic exactly; unscreened source–receiver pairs skip the barrier search entirely; terrain and building-seam checks run in batches; and the refinement worker pool starts while the grid is still being partitioned.
